info.title: Fleet Maintenance Log System API
info.description:
REST API documentation. Register creates a USER account. Log in to receive a JWT, then enter it using Authorize for protected endpoints.

Use an existing account; examples are not seeded credentials. Paste only the JWT into Authorize. Try it out writes to the real database. Reports are generated in the frontend using maintenance and repair data; there is no separate reports REST endpoint.
